implementation.targetScope: All 17 Primitive DOM components, Root alias, asChild/ref forwarding and synchronous discrete custom-event dispatch on React 19. No copied upstream runtime.

changes: Create named Slot wrappers only for tags that actually use asChild, retaining stable identities thereafter.
Build the component table once and reuse the copied prop record when forwarding refs.
Load ReactDOM for discrete-event dispatch only when that helper is called.
Use the independently written VPM Slot/ref stack with React 19 peers.
